blocks.text: Tailwind finds class names by reading your source files as text. Complete class names let it discover the styles you need.

These examples use Tailwind CSS 4 in a separate project. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/cli. Put @import "tailwindcss"; in input.css and build with npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css. Link output.css in HTML.

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: Each map entry contains full class names that the build scanner can see.
`colours.success` chooses the success string; it does not build a partly hidden class name.

blocks.text: Both complete class strings can be discovered during a Tailwind build. The selected value is the success string.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not build a class such as bg-${colour}-100 from pieces and expect the scanner to guess every possible result.
